own_scenes.desc: Las listas preferían canciones de relajación y huida: «Hanky Panky», «Wild Thing», «Sunny» de Bobby Hebb, el «Summertime» de Billy Stewart, «Sunshine Superman» de Donovan y, sobre todo, «Summer in the City» de los Lovin’ Spoonful, número 1 en agosto, con taladros y bocinas en las pausas; su anuncio en Billboard (niños negros jugando con una boca de incendios) se cumplió con el motín de la boca de riego del West Side de Chicago. En Inglaterra, tras ganar el Mundial, sonaban «Out of Time» de Chris Farlowe (de Jagger y Richards, en Immediate) y «Sunny Afternoon» de los Kinks, el suspiro de un boom que se deshinchaba con la congelación de salarios de Wilson (20 de julio): fin de los altos sesenta británicos. Los Who acabaron a patadas el festival de jazz y blues de Windsor. John Rechy puso «Dirty Water», «Hungry», «Summer in the City» y «Paint It, Black» de banda sonora a la desesperación de Numbers.

refs.para: The fastest riser was ‘Summer in the City’, the fifth single by the Lovin’ Spoonful, which went from #21 to #7 in the Billboard chart of 30 July. This would be the American song of the summer, reaching #1 on 13 August and staying there for three weeks. By the end of the month, there would be four sunny summer songs – ‘Summer in the City’ at #1, ‘Sunny’ at #2, Donovan’s ‘Sunshine Superman’ at #5 and ‘Summertime’ at #10 – in the US Top 10, just as the temperature reached 32ºC in New York.
refs.chapter: Agosto: Do You Come Here Often? Joe Meek, los derechos gais y un verano de violencia

refs.q: With its jagged edges and rampaging beat, ‘Summer in the City’ reflected a season not of relaxation, but of riot and disturbance.
refs.para: With its jagged edges and rampaging beat, ‘Summer in the City’ reflected a season not of relaxation, but of riot and disturbance. The 2 July Billboard advert for the single showed three young Negro boys, in silhouette, playing with a fire hydrant, with the copy: ‘The Lovin’ Spoonful captures the feel, the heartbeat of Summer in the City.’ The promise that this would be the ‘single of the season’ was fulfilled by the fire-hydrant riot in Chicago’s West Side.
